messages:
alex: FYI AtlasBio POC moved to procurement. They returned an order form + DPA with several redlines. Uploaded to ticket.

maria: Thanks. They99re pushing 99.9% SLA for the POC (6 weeks). Can we accept that? :grimacing:

sam: Procurement discrepancy: their PO in Coupa is AT-2026-901 but AP email lists AT-2026-901-B. Need confirmation before invoicing. Also need W-9/EIN and payment term confirmation.

jordan: Legal quick read: they removed our KMS custody clause, expanded audit rights, and inserted a mutual indemnity change. I'll draft a counter. We should resist deleting KMS for PHI.

lee-privacy: Privacy: AtlasBio asks for subprocessor restriction + continuous log access. We can provide SOC2 report and subprocessors list; live log access not feasible. Offer daily S3 exports and a scoped forensic export process for incidents.

maria: SLA compromise suggestion: Offer "Pilot SLA" 99.5% for POC with upgrade to 99.9% on migration to dedicated capacity. That limits exposure during pilot.

sam: Finance: Standard is Net30. Net45 requires RevOps approval and a credit check. If they insist on Net45, ask for POE or prepay.

rachel: Signature routing: AtlasBio requires CFO + CISO signatures. DocuSign OK. They also require the PO attached and a checkbox "PO matches invoice". Do we have a template for that?

alex: We don't auto-attach PO for deals; manual attach is fine. Rachel, can you prepare envelope and include the checkbox? Sequence: Atlas CFO -> Atlas CISO -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood Finance.

rachel: Yes. I'll prepare envelope and include metadata field `supplier_tax_id` for Coupa. Sam, please confirm EIN so I can add it to the envelope metadata.

jordan: Counter plan: 1) Preserve KMS/customer-managed keys for PHI. 2) Limit audit to SOC2 + remote evidence; on-site only with 30 days' notice and scope-limited. 3) Cap uptime credits to monthly invoice. I'll produce a redline today.

maria: Support add-on: commercial suggests 24/7 for POC as an opt-in add-on at $6k/week and an onboarding manager at $3.5k/week. We should present as optional line items.

lee-privacy: I'll upload subprocessors list + SOC2 cert to ticket and flag what we can share for the DPA. Also confirm we allow customer-managed keys but no escrow requirement.

sam: Atlas AP replied: final PO is AT-2026-901-B and EIN is 11-2233445. They asked for Net45 but agreed Net30 to speed POC. Sending W-9 now.

legal_team_bot: NOTICE 97 Using MSA v3.2. Default redline template applied: preserve KMS clause for PHI, audit limited to SOC2 + scoped on-site. See /contracts/drafts/AT-901 for draft.

alex: Order form (draft):
```
Order Form: AtlasBio POC
- Term: 6 weeks
- Commit: $42,000 total
- Billing: Net30 (PO AT-2026-901-B)
- SLA: Pilot SLA 99.5% (upgrade path to 99.9% on dedicated)
- Support: Business hours included; 24/7 optional add-on
- KMS: Customer-managed keys required for PHI workloads
```

rachel: DocuSign checklist: attach Order Form + PO + DPA counter + SOC2. Add metadata `supplier_tax_id` = "11-2233445". Include required checkbox: "PO matches invoice and terms" for Atlas CFO.

jordan: Posted counter-redline: /contracts/drafts/AT-901-msaredline.pdf. Key changes summarized in the doc. Please review for urgent feedback.

maria: Reviewed redline SLA language. Pilot SLA 99.5% looks good. I'll confirm support add-on pricing to procurement.

lee-privacy: Uploaded `soc2_atlas_2025.pdf` and `subprocessors_atlas.csv` to the ticket. Added note: daily S3 export for logs, 90-day retention exportable on request.

sam: Finance confirmed Net30. I'll proceed with vendor onboarding after executed contract. Note: invoice must reference AT-2026-901-B exactly.

rachel: Sent DocuSign envelope to Atlas CFO. Attachments: Order Form (redline v1), DPA counter, PO (AT-2026-901-B), SOC2. Included supplier_tax_id metadata.

alex: Great. Summary of next steps:
- Jordan to finalize MSA/DPA counter today.
- Lee to provide SOC2 + subprocessors (done).
- Maria to confirm support add-on pricing.
- Sam to do vendor onboarding after signature.
- Rachel to finalize DocuSign flow and attach executed docs to HubSpot.

rachel: Will attach executed contract to HubSpot and trigger provisioning request once fully signed. :white_check_mark:

alex: Closing loop: SalesOps to attach signed artifacts to deal record and open provisioning ticket. Thanks everyone.
